notablePrerequisites: The total number of cards in your library and hand is at least equal to the highest life total among your opponents.
description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Cast Ad Nauseum by paying {3}{B}{B}, putting your entire library in your hand and losing life equal to the total converted mana cost of those cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar many times by discarding your entire hand, adding {B} for each card discarded.
Actviate Pestilence many times by paying {B} each time, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player each time.
